Red acceptance tests for re-cinq/HALEngine#93: afterModelResponse
receives the last round's usage alone, so a tool-heavy turn under-
counts. The tests pin the chosen shape - totalUsage as the sum over
every provider call that reported, roundUsage as the per-round
breakdown - and keep the no-tool path pinned by the existing test.

The spec's recorded under-counting line is replaced by the new
behaviour, cited to the red tests; .lore/dod.md records the decision
and the rejected alternative.
